sources.title: Original extrapolation authors: eye-disease figures for Germany, published October 2018, updated September 2020
sources.read_extent: Entire substantive counts, methods, definitions, references, author/date sections
sources.check_performed: Original researcher Schuster and DBSV Lenk describe extrapolation to 31 December 2017 population. AMD estimates are 6,981,000 early-stage and 488,000 late-stage. Ages outside regional GHS ages 35–74 use international age-specific synthesis and conservative boundaries; disease definitions matter. This identifies a plausible primary basis for broad seven-million scale; not all blindness, membership or a new September 2026 census.
sources.temporal_limit: DBSV coauthored this source, so it is method provenance rather than independent confirmation. Extrapolation date/stages differ from exact composite current count.
